blurb.en: Thinking of something we do not list yet? Tell us what you need and we will source it.
blurb.zh: 想要目前未列出的款式？告诉我们您的需求，我们会为您寻找。

features.en: Tell us the feature you want
features.zh: 告诉我们您想要的功能

blurb.en: Have a specific feature in mind? Describe it and we will tell you what is possible.
blurb.zh: 心中已有特定功能？描述给我们，我们会告诉您可行方案。

blurb.en: Unusual mailbox or an unusual requirement? Send a photo and we will advise.
blurb.zh: 信箱特殊或需求特别？传张照片，我们会给您建议。

features.en: Send a photo of the mailbox

included.en: Supply of your chosen letterbox lock
Removal of the old lock mechanism
Code set up with you, or keys handed over
included.zh: 协助设定密码或交付钥匙

note.en: Only if the mailbox is locked and you have no key. A typical open-and-replace job therefore starts at S$75.
note.zh: 仅当信箱上锁且无钥匙时收取。开锁加换锁通常 S$75 起。

note.en: Special arrangement outside our planned route. Stated in writing before we travel.
note.zh: 在既定路线之外的特别安排。出发前以书面告知。

note.en: Repair may be needed before any lock will seat properly.
note.zh: 锁具需先修复门板才能正确安装。

note.en: Custom, imported or landed mailboxes may need a different solution.
note.zh: 订制、进口或有地住宅信箱可能需要其他方案。

note.en: Assessed on site and quoted in writing — often a service job rather than a replacement.
note.zh: 现场评估并书面报价 — 通常只需维修而非更换。

text.en: Not a general locksmith. We do not take door, gate, car or safe work, so we carry the right parts and finish most jobs on the first visit.
text.zh: 我们不是一般锁匠。不接大门、闸门、汽车或保险箱，因此备齐正确零件，多数一次到场完成。

text.en: Locked out of your mail at midnight? We answer round the clock, every day of the year, and urgent installation slots are available.
text.zh: 半夜取不到信？我们全年无休、24 小时接听，并提供紧急安装时段。

text.en: Our combination models need no battery, ever. Nothing to charge, nothing to fail at the wrong moment.
text.zh: 密码款完全不用电池。不必充电，不会在关键时刻失灵。

text.en: We send you a video of the finished, tested lock. You confirm it is right, then you pay. Nothing is charged before that.
text.zh: 我们会传送完工测试影片。您确认无误后才付款，在此之前不收任何费用。

text.en: If we confirmed a model from your photo and it does not fit, you pay nothing — including no attendance fee.
text.zh: 若我们依照片确认的型号装不上，您完全不必付费 — 包括上门费。

text.en: We group jobs by area each day, so you get a confirmed arrival window instead of waiting in all afternoon.
text.zh: 每天按区域规划路线，给您确定的到达时段，不必等整个下午。

title.en: Most jobs done in one visit

text.en: We carry every model we list, plus the cams and nuts that go with them. No ordering in, no second trip.
text.zh: 我们车上备有所列的每款型号与相应五金。不必另外订货，也不用跑第二趟。

text.en: We verify you are the resident, owner, tenant or authorised person before opening any locked mailbox. ID is sighted only, never copied.
text.zh: 开锁前核实您是住户、屋主、租户或授权人。证件只查看，绝不复印或留存。

text.en: Handover-ready locks fitted to your schedule, one consistent model across every unit, and a single consolidated invoice.
text.zh: 配合您的工期安装，整个项目使用统一型号，并开立单一整合发票。

text.en: Whole-development mailbox bank fit-out before TOP or handover, surveyed first and completed as a scheduled programme.
text.zh: 临时入伙准证或交屋前完成整栋信箱安装，先行勘察并按排程完成。

text.en: Block-wide replacement in one coordinated visit, with a written per-unit scope your committee can approve.
text.zh: 一次上门完成整栋更换，提供委员会可审批的逐户书面范围。

text.en: Estate-scale programmes across multiple blocks, sequenced so residents keep access to their mail throughout.
text.zh: 跨多栋的全楼盘工程，依序施作，住户全程可取信。

text.en: Between-tenancy lock changes so an outgoing tenant's key or code never opens the next tenant's mail.
text.zh: 租客交替时更换锁具，确保前租客无法开启下一位租客的信件。

text.en: One lock, one visit, one written price — the same service and warranty as our largest projects.
text.zh: 一个锁、一次上门、一个书面价格 — 与最大型项目同样的服务与保固。

text.en: Shared mail rooms in shophouses, industrial units and small offices, fitted outside your business hours.
text.zh: 店屋、工业单位与小型办公室的共用信件室，可在营业时间外安装。

text.en: Whatever the need, it is handled by the same specialist from quote to completion. No subcontractors, no handover.
text.zh: 无论何种需求，皆由同一位专家从报价到完工负责。不转包，不交接。

short.en: Pick a model or send a photo. Add your block and unit in the chat.
short.zh: 选择型号或传照片，在对话中提供座号与单位。

text.en: Pick a model from the list, or just send a photo of your mailbox front and let us recommend one. Add your block and unit in the chat so we can schedule the visit. No deposit and no card details.
text.zh: 从列表选择型号，或直接传信箱正面照片让我们推荐。在对话中提供座号与单位以便安排上门。无需订金，不需信用卡资料。

short.en: Standard runs are free. Urgent installation adds S$10.
short.zh: 标准行程免费。紧急安装加 S$10。

text.en: Your job is slotted into the next run that passes your postal sector, and you get a confirmed arrival window before we set off. Need it sooner? Choose urgent installation and we make a special arrangement to reach you, for S$10.
text.zh: 您的工作会排入下一趟经过您邮区的行程，出发前给您确定的到达时段。需要更快？选择紧急安装，我们会为您特别安排，加收 S$10。

short.en: We fit, align and test it, then send you a short video.
short.zh: 安装、校准、测试，然后传短片给您。

text.en: The old mechanism is removed, the new lock fitted and aligned, your code set or keys handed over. We record a short video of the finished lock opening and closing, and send it to you.
text.zh: 拆除旧锁、安装校准新锁、设定密码或交付钥匙。我们会录下完工锁具开关的短片并传给您。

short.en: Watch the video or test it yourself. Not right? We fix it first.
short.zh: 看影片或自行测试。不满意？我们先修正。

text.en: Watch the video, or test it yourself if you are home. If anything is not right, tell us and we put it right before any payment is due.
text.zh: 观看影片，或在家自行测试。若有任何不妥，告诉我们，我们会在收款前处理好。

short.en: PayNow, cash or transfer — at the written price, never more.
short.zh: PayNow、现金或转账 — 按书面价格，绝不加价。

text.en: Once you are satisfied, settle the written price by PayNow, cash or bank transfer. The figure never changes from the written quote unless you asked for extra work.
text.zh: 满意后以 PayNow、现金或银行转账支付书面价格。除非您另外要求加工，否则金额绝不会变动。

text.en: Lost my letterbox key on a Sunday. Sent a photo, got a price, and it was opened and re-keyed within two hours. Very fair rate.
text.zh: 星期天弄丢信箱钥匙。传了照片、拿到报价，两小时内就开锁换好了。价格很公道。

text.en: Upgraded to a keyless PIN lock. Clean installation, tested everything and showed me how to reset the code. Highly recommend.
text.zh: 升级成免钥匙密码锁。安装整齐，全部测试过，还教我怎么重设密码。非常推荐。

text.zh: 我们整栋的管理机构请他们做批量更换。一次预约、单一发票，省心。很划算。

text.en: Jammed lock replaced within hours of calling. Transparent pricing with no hidden charges. Friendly and professional.
text.zh: 打电话后几小时内就换好卡住的锁。价格透明没有隐藏费用。态度友善又专业。

text.en: Responsive on WhatsApp and arrived on time. The battery-free lock is exactly what I wanted — nothing to charge.
text.zh: WhatsApp 回复很快，准时到达。免电池的锁正是我要的 — 不用充电。

text.en: Elderly mother kept losing keys, so we went with a keyless code lock. She finds it so much easier now. Thank you!
text.zh: 年迈的母亲老是弄丢钥匙，所以换了免钥匙密码锁。她现在觉得方便多了。谢谢！

q.en: How much does a letterbox lock installation cost in Singapore?
q.zh: 新加坡换信箱锁多少钱？

a.en: Supply and installation starts from S$50 for a standard HDB or condo letterbox. If the mailbox is locked and the key is lost, opening adds S$25 per unit, so a typical open-and-replace job starts at S$75. Digital touch-PIN models start at S$60 and the range tops out at S$85. Urgent installation adds S$10. The final price is confirmed in writing after we review your photo.
a.zh: 标准组屋或公寓信箱，供应加安装 S$50 起。若信箱已上锁且钥匙遗失，每个加收 S$25 开锁费，因此开锁加换锁通常 S$75 起。数码触控密码款 S$60 起，全系列最高 S$85。紧急安装加 S$10。我们看过您的照片后会以书面确认最终价格。

a.en: Yes. We answer WhatsApp and phone round the clock, every day of the year, including public holidays. Late-night and early-morning lost-key openings are a regular part of what we do. Urgent installation, at any hour, carries a S$10 surcharge, stated in writing before we travel — there is no separate night rate and no emergency multiplier.
a.zh: 是的。我们全年无休、24 小时接听 WhatsApp 与电话，公共假期也不例外。深夜与清晨的钥匙遗失开锁是我们日常工作的一部分。紧急安装（任何时间）加收 S$10，出发前以书面告知 — 没有另外的夜间费率，也没有紧急加成。

q.en: Do you service HDB and condo letterboxes islandwide?
q.zh: 全岛的组屋和公寓信箱都服务吗？

a.en: Yes. We cover every HDB town and condominium in Singapore, plus landed homes and outdoor mailboxes. We plan routes across the island each day, so your job is slotted into the next run passing your postal sector and you get a confirmed arrival window before we travel.
a.zh: 是的。我们涵盖新加坡所有组屋区与公寓，也包括有地住宅与户外信箱。我们每天规划全岛路线，您的工作会排入下一趟经过您邮区的行程，出发前提供确定的到达时段。

q.en: I lost my letterbox key. Can you help?
q.zh: 我弄丢信箱钥匙了，能帮忙吗？

a.en: Yes. We open the locked mailbox and fit a replacement lock the same visit. Opening starts from S$25 per unit and we verify on site that you are the resident, owner, tenant or an authorised person before anything is opened.
a.zh: 可以。我们会在同一次上门开启上锁的信箱并安装新锁。开锁每个 S$25 起，开启前会在现场核实您是住户、屋主、租户或授权人。

a.en: After the job is done and you have confirmed it. We install the lock, send you a short video of it working, and you only pay once you are satisfied. There is no deposit, nothing to pay online and no card details taken.
a.zh: 完工并经您确认后才付款。我们安装好锁、传送运作短片，您满意后才付费。无需订金，不需线上付款，也不收取信用卡资料。

q.en: Is there a letterbox lock that does not need a battery?
q.zh: 有不用电池的信箱锁吗？

a.en: Yes — most of our range. Our combination models (P2, P3, P5, P6, P8 and P9) have no battery at all, so there is nothing to charge and nothing to fail. Only the digital touch-PIN models (P4 and P7) use a replaceable battery, and those warn you before it runs low.
a.zh: 有 — 我们大部分型号都是。密码款（P2、P3、P5、P6、P8 与 P9）完全不用电池，不必充电也不会失灵。只有数码触控密码款（P4 与 P7）使用可更换电池，且会在电量偏低前提醒您。

q.en: How long does a letterbox lock replacement take?

a.en: Most single replacements take 15 to 30 minutes once we are on site and the mailbox is accessible. Bulk jobs for a whole block are scheduled as one coordinated visit.
a.zh: 到场且信箱可接触的情况下，单个更换多数需 15 至 30 分钟。整栋批量工程会安排为一次统筹上门。

q.en: Do I need HDB or MCST approval to change my letterbox lock?
q.zh: 换信箱锁需要建屋局或管理机构批准吗？

a.en: For your own unit's letterbox you do not normally need approval — the lock is yours to maintain. For a block-wide or common-area mailbox bank, the MCST, managing agent or town council must approve the works first, and we help prepare that request before anything is scheduled.
a.zh: 自己单位的信箱通常不需要批准 — 锁具由您自行维护。若是整栋或公共区域的信箱组，须先经管理机构、物业经理或市镇理事会批准，我们会在排程前协助准备申请。

q.en: Can you match the existing lock on my letterbox?
q.zh: 能配合我信箱原本的锁吗？

a.en: In most cases, yes. Send one straight-on photo of the mailbox front and we identify the cut-out, cam type and swivel direction, then confirm in writing which model fits. If we confirm a model and it does not fit on site, you pay nothing — including no attendance fee.
a.zh: 多数情况可以。传一张信箱正面的正视照片，我们会辨识开孔、锁舌类型与转向，然后书面确认适合的型号。若我们确认的型号现场装不上，您完全不必付费 — 包括上门费。

q.en: Do you charge a call-out fee?

a.en: No call-out fee and no attendance fee. Standard visits on our daily route carry no travel charge at all. The only additional charge is S$10 for urgent installation, a special arrangement outside our planned route — and that figure is in your written quote before we travel.
a.zh: 没有上门费，也没有出勤费。日常路线上的标准上门完全不收车马费。唯一的额外费用是紧急安装的 S$10，这是既定路线之外的特别安排 — 该金额会在出发前列于书面报价中。

q.en: Do you work with interior designers and new construction projects?
q.zh: 你们接室内设计师与新建工程的项目吗？

a.en: Yes. We are a one-stop letterbox lock solution for interior designers, renovation firms, developers, MCSTs, managing agents, town councils, property agents and landlords, as well as individual residents. Projects get one consistent model across every unit, a written per-unit scope, work scheduled around your handover or TOP date, and a single consolidated invoice.
a.zh: 接。我们为室内设计师、装修公司、发展商、管理机构、物业经理、市镇理事会、房产经纪与房东，以及个别住户，提供一站式信箱锁解决方案。项目可全数采用统一型号，提供逐户书面范围，配合交屋或临时入伙准证日期排程，并开立单一整合发票。
